THE PATTERN IN YOUR AUDIT
You kept IMG_4684 (A4) and IMG_4707 (this) and IMG_4702.
Every dollar-figure clip came back KEEP.
That is a decision about the money rule whether or not it was
meant as one. Make it explicitly with Shavit rather than by
letting three reels drift into production.

IF IT SHIPS, THE ENDING SAVES IT
He closes on “the most important thing, a new family that’s
getting a house.” That is the same people-before-property beat
that made A1 work, and it is what stops the reel reading as
a brag about a spread.
Fallback recut: keep the structure, drop every number, end on
that same line. Works without anyone’s permission.
